description: bench/*.py under CPython, the Pystachy JIT and AOT, as bench/run.sh times them (whole process; JIT includes compilation and startup; AOT excludes its build), 5 rounds per program, mode order rotated each round, every process pinned to one CPU; combined stdout+stderr of every run equals CPython's
note: the compiler, runtime and library sources of the measured commit equal those of the v0.4.0-alpha.3 release commit c5cebb8bdeb71e7e099b48e4400119dd1e5b29e2; json_records.py, list_reads.py and optional_scalars.py run for 16 to 25 ms under CPython, too short to time this way: their samples are kept but docs/performance.md leaves them out
